name: @dust-dice/contract

scripts.compact: npm run compact:dice && npm run compact:turn && npm run compact:scoring && npm run compact:takeTurn && npm run compact:table && npm run compact:lobby
scripts.compact:fast: compact compile --skip-zk src/dice.compact src/managed/dice && compact compile --skip-zk src/turn.compact src/managed/turn && compact compile --skip-zk src/scoring.compact src/managed/scoring && compact compile --skip-zk src/takeTurn.compact src/managed/takeTurn && COMPACT_PATH=$PWD/src compact compile --skip-zk src/table.compact src/managed/table && COMPACT_PATH=$PWD/src compact compile --skip-zk src/lobby.compact src/managed/lobby
scripts.//build:skip-zk: .github/workflows/ci.yml calls `npm run build:skip-zk -w contract --if-present`, and until now no such script existed -- so `--if-present` silently skipped it, src/managed was never generated in CI, and `npm test` could not have been passing there. Aliased to compact:fast rather than renaming it, so the CI workflow needs no change.
scripts.format:compact: compact format src/dice-core.compact src/dice.compact src/turn.compact src/scoring-core.compact src/scoring.compact src/takeTurn.compact src/policy-core.compact src/table.compact src/lobby.compact
scripts.measure: scripts/measure-build.sh build/measure && node scripts/zkir-stats.mjs build/measure/dice-zk build/measure/turn-zk build/measure/scoring-zk build/measure/takeTurn-zk build/measure/table-zk build/measure/lobby-zk
scripts.zkir-stats: node scripts/zkir-stats.mjs src/managed/dice src/managed/turn src/managed/scoring src/managed/takeTurn src/managed/table src/managed/lobby
scripts.//test: --experimental-transform-types, not the default strip-only mode: the scoring cross-check imports api/src/rules.ts, whose `export enum Category` strip-only refuses (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX -- an enum has runtime behaviour that cannot be erased). See docs/scoring-circuit.md.
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && for m in dice turn scoring takeTurn table lobby; do mkdir -p dist/managed/$m && cp -R src/managed/$m/contract dist/managed/$m/contract; done && for m in table lobby; do for d in keys zkir; do [ -d src/managed/$m/$d ] && cp -R src/managed/$m/$d dist/managed/$m/$d; done; done; true
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.//compact: table.compact and lobby.compact `include "policy-core"`, so COMPACT_PATH must point at src/. The four measurement contracts do not need it (their includes resolve relative to the source), but setting it uniformly keeps the two halves of this list from diverging.
scripts.prepublishOnly: test $(ls dist/managed/table/keys/*.verifier 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 9 && test -d dist/managed/lobby/keys || { echo 'refusing to publish: dist/managed lacks the proving keys — run a FULL `npm run compact` (not compact:fast) and `npm run build` first'; exit 1; }

//build: dist/managed carries compiled JS for all six modules but keys+zkir only for the two deployables (table, lobby): the four sub-modules' keys are measurement builds nobody deploys, and they would triple the tarball.
//prepublishOnly: A skip-ZK compile (CI) builds a dist without keys; a tarball made from it would install but could never prove. The guard makes that a loud failure instead of a silently broken package.
